The '''''Stalker''''' was the personal [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] of the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] and [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Darth Cognus]], also known as the Huntress. She flew in this [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to the [[Stone Prison]] on [[Doan]] after [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capturing]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] from [[Darth Bane's mansion|his mansion]] on [[Ciutric IV]] at the orders of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Serra]]. [[Set Harth]] later attempted to steal the ''Stalker'' to flee from the Stone [[Prison/Legends|Prison]], but Cognus found him before he could escape. During their ensuing [[Skirmish in the Stone Prison hangar|skirmish]] in the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], Serra set off a detonator that would collapse the entire prison, and Harth quickly disabled three of the five vessels. He then threatened to destroy the remaining two&mdash;the ''Stalker'' and his own starship&mdash;which would cause both of them to die in the prison's collapse. He proposed that she allow him to escape, in which case he would leave her ship unharmed. She agreed to let him flee and then remained in the hangar until Darth Bane's arrival. Recognizing her as his captor, he made as if to attack her, but she submitted herself to him, giving him his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]&mdash;which she had taken after capturing him&mdash;and offering herself to be his apprentice. He accepted, and she flew him to [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]] in the ''Stalker'' to hunt down Serra, who had tortured him in the Prison.
